<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider, type Announcements, type Key } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Agenda from './Agenda.vue';
import { LANGUAGES } from './texts';

const agenda = ref([
  { id: 'welcome', title: 'Welcome', minutes: 5 },
  { id: 'roadmap', title: 'Roadmap', minutes: 15 },
  { id: 'demo', title: 'Live demo', minutes: 10 },
  { id: 'questions', title: 'Questions', minutes: 10 },
]);
const lang = ref('en');
const texts = computed(() => LANGUAGES[lang.value]!);

// Every text handed to the live region, newest first.
const spoken = ref<{ id: number; text: string }[]>([]);
let count = 0;
const say = (text: string) => {
  if (spoken.value[0]?.text !== text) spoken.value = [{ id: ++count, text }, ...spoken.value].slice(0, 4);
  return text;
};

const titleOf = (id: Key) => agenda.value.find((item) => item.id === id)?.title ?? String(id);

// `position` is where the built-in texts say the item is: picked up at, moving to, dropped
// at, back at. `index` counts from 0.
const announcements = computed<Partial<Announcements>>(() => {
  const t = texts.value;
  return {
    onDragStart: ({ active }, { position }) =>
      position && say(t.start(titleOf(active.id), position.index + 1, position.length)),
    onDragOver: ({ active }, { position }) =>
      position && say(t.move(titleOf(active.id), position.index + 1, position.length)),
    onDragEnd: ({ active }, { position }) =>
      position && say(t.drop(titleOf(active.id), position.index + 1, position.length)),
    onDragCancel: ({ active }, { position }) => position && say(t.cancel(titleOf(active.id), position.index + 1)),
    onDragResume: ({ active }) => say(t.resume(titleOf(active.id))),
  };
});
</script>

<template>

  <div :lang="lang">
  <DnDProvider :announcements="announcements" :screen-reader-instructions="texts.instructions">
    <div class="demo">
      <div class="languages" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Language of the announcements">
        <label v-for="(language, code) in LANGUAGES" :key="code" :class="{ on: lang === code }">

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, shallowRef, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Shortcut from './Shortcut.vue';

defineProps<{ attributes: boolean }>();

const shortcuts = ref([
  { id: 'docs', title: 'Vue docs', kind: 'link' as const, href: 'https://vuejs.org' },
  { id: 'note', title: 'New note', kind: 'button' as const },
  { id: 'inbox', title: 'Inbox', kind: 'plain' as const },
  { id: 'archive', title: 'Archive', kind: 'handle' as const },
]);
const notes = ref(0);

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, { items: shortcuts });

// The inspector: the role, tabindex and aria-* attributes of the element that has (or
// last had) the focus, read again whenever an attribute changes.
const inspected = shallowRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const rows = ref<{ name: string; value: string }[]>([]);
const read = () => {
  const element = inspected.value;
  rows.value = element
    ? [...element.attributes]
        .filter(({ name }) => name === 'role' || name === 'tabindex' || name.startsWith('aria-'))
        .map(({ name, value }) => ({ name, value }))
    : [];
};
// Its name: the label of the grip, or the title of the shortcut.
const name = computed(
  () => inspected.value?.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? inspected.value?.querySelector('.title')?.textContent ?? '',
);
const inspect = (event: FocusEvent) => {
  inspected.value = event.target as HTMLElement;
  read();
};
// What `aria-describedby` points to: the text a screen reader reads after the name.
const description = computed(() => {
  const ids = rows.value.find((row) => row.name === 'aria-describedby')?.value ?? '';
  return ids
    .split(' ')
    .map((id) => (id ? document.getElementById(id)?.textContent : ''))
    .join(' ')
    .trim();
});

const observer = typeof MutationObserver === 'undefined' ? null : new MutationObserver(read);
onMounted(() => {
  if (list.value) observer?.observe(list.value, { attributes: true, subtree: true });
  inspected.value = list.value?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-roledescription]') ?? null;
  read();
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
</script>

          :attributes="attributes"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{
  book: { id: string; title: string; author: string };
  index: number;
  count: number;
  /** Take the focus: the row before it was just marked as read. */
  focused: boolean;
}>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ move: [to: number]; finish: [] }>();

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// The grip drags (pointer and keyboard); the buttons move without dragging.
makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.book, handle: '.grip' });

const up = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('up');
const down = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('down');
const done = useTemplateRef<HTMLButtonElement>('done');

const move = async (direction: 'up' | 'down') => {
  emit('move', direction === 'up' ? props.index - 1 : props.index + 1);
  await nextTick();
  // Moving the row in the DOM loses the focus: put it back on the same button, or on
  // the other one when this one is now disabled (the top or the bottom of the list).
  const same = direction === 'up' ? up.value : down.value;
  const other = direction === 'up' ? down.value : up.value;
  (same?.disabled ? other : same)?.focus();
};

watch(
  () => props.focused,
  (value) => value && done.value?.focus(),
  { flush: 'post' },
);
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import BookRow from './BookRow.vue';

const books = ref([
  { id: 'dune', title: 'Dune', author: 'Frank Herbert' },
  { id: 'emma', title: 'Emma', author: 'Jane Austen' },
  { id: 'beloved', title: 'Beloved', author: 'Toni Morrison' },
  { id: 'solaris', title: 'Solaris', author: 'Stanisław Lem' },
]);

const list = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');
// `animateChanges`: moves made by the buttons (no drag) slide too, and stay still for users
// who ask for reduced motion.
const { items } = makeSortableList(list, { id: 'reading', items: books, animateChanges: true });

// Buttons change the data, not a drag: the provider says nothing, so this region does.
const message = ref('');

const move = (from: number, to: number) => {
  const next = [...books.value];
  const [book] = next.splice(from, 1);
  next.splice(to, 0, book!);
  books.value = next;
  message.value = `${book!.title} moved to position ${to + 1} of ${next.length}.`;
};

// The row of the book marked as read goes away, and its focus with it: the next row
// (or the last one) takes it.
const focused = ref<string | null>(null);
const finish = (index: number) => {
  const [book] = books.value.splice(index, 1);
  message.value = `${book!.title} marked as read. ${books.value.length} left.`;
  focused.value = books.value[Math.min(index, books.value.length - 1)]?.id ?? null;
};
</script>

<template>
  <section class="reading">
    <h3>Up next</h3>
    <ol ref="list" class="books">
      <BookRow
        v-for="(book, index) in items"
        :key="book.id"
        :book="book"
        :index="index"
        :count="items.length"
        :focused="focused === book.id"
        @move="(to) => move(index, to)"
        @finish="finish(index)"
      />
    </ol>
    <p v-if="!items.length" class="empty">All read.</p>
    <p class="status" role="status">{{ message }}</p>
  </section>
</template>
